title.narrative: 7th National Communication of Mexico to the UNFCCC - Adaptation component

description.narrative: Support the Government of Mexico in the preparation of the final draft of the Vulnerability and Adaptation to Climate Change chapter of the 7th National Communication of Mexico to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (UNFCCC) based on the review of existing literature, analysis and collection of information at the national and subnational level from 2018 to 2024, in compliance with the index established in Decision 17/CP.8 of the Convention. To inform the international community and the Mexican population of the progress in adaptation to climate change in Mexico, provide a general overview of the actions and measures carried out by the different actors involved, and highlight good practices, opportunities and challenges to reduce vulnerability to the differentiated impacts of climate change on social and natural systems in the national territory with a gender, human rights, and intercultural approach, and considering local, traditional, and people's knowledge of natives.

To enhance Mexico’s capacity to address climate change by producing a robust and comprehensive Vulnerability and Adaptation chapter that informs national adaptation strategies, improves climate resilience, and strengthens Mexico’s international climate reporting.
